brief: Two separate pairs of bases, the pairs joined to each other only with side connectors.

requirements.requirement: Two separate pairs of bases (four bases total organized as two pairs)
requirements.evidence: 4 bases: piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full forming left pair, piece:2,0,0;full, piece:3,0,0;full forming right pair, arranged linearly on level 0

requirements.requirement: The pairs joined to each other only with side connectors (no other joining)
requirements.evidence: 3 side connectors: connector:0#0,0|1,0 within left pair, connector:0#2,0|3,0 within right pair, and connector:0#1,0|2,0 bridging the two pairs. No caps, covers or other joints bridging; meshClash clear.

finish.summary: Built 4 full hex bases in a line as two adjacent pairs (0,0-1,0 and 2,0-3,0) with side connectors within each pair and a single side connector joining the pairs. All connections are side-connector type only.

lines.key: pvc-section-double  (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))
lines.label: pvc-section-double (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes

events.text: Two isolated pairs linked only by connectors — I'll set up your build.

result.note: A side connector joins two bases that stand side by side on the same storey. No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.
